description: Watchdog timeout mid-turn (fires inside the 2.5s bash window, comfortably after the first stream completes): same aborted contract as a user stop, and the headless exit contract maps it to 3

checks.name: aborted-turn-end
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
log = os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']
ends = []
for line in open(log):
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e.get('type') == 'turn/end':
        ends.append(e['data']['reason'])
assert ends, 'no turn/end in log'
assert ends[-1]['kind'] == 'aborted', ends[-1]
assert ends[-1].get('cause') == 'user', ends[-1]
"

checks.name: no-stray-turn-after-abort
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
log = os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']
turns = []
for line in open(log):
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e.get('type') == 'turn/start': turns.append(e['data']['turn'])
assert turns == sorted(set(turns)), turns
"
